svg.title: Snowflake export: one click sends a board's confirmed threats to the user's own Snowflake account. Our API turns each threat into a row and runs four statements over the SQL REST API with the user's access token: create the table, create three chart views, delete the board's old rows, and insert every threat in one bound statement. Snowsight charts the views with no SQL, and the token is never stored.
svg.text: SQL REST API, in your own warehouse
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS threat_findings
so a resend replaces the board
every threat in one bound statement
with no SQL from the user
